permits.description: work includes a small rear horizontal addition at the existing 1st and 2nd flrs, a new basement level below the house. for a garage and storage spaces, and an interior remodel of other existing spaces of the home. exterior improvements include new garage door, reframe existing front walk-up stairs.

change of use from an 2 unit commercial use to sfd use. minor kitchen remodel to install a new domestic range & exhaust hood, install new bathroom exhaust fans & combination smoke / carbon monoxide detectos where required. no exterior work proposed.

remove existing composition shingles and replace with new "in kind" composition shingles on roof, class "a" fire rated. 2) certainteed flintlastic modified bitumen membrane roofing system along with an approved certainteed sa base sheet. no change to the facade, roofline or appearance.
renewal permit ap#200409093661 & 3200601192474 for final inspection only.

this is a historic building. certain specific areas in this bldg are required by the city to be protected with fire sprinklers. the scope of work is to install fire sprinklers. to protected these requied areas, which are specified on the approve plan with pa# 2004/09/09/3661. work on all 3 floors.
legalize office use for 2nd, 3rd and attic storeys. existing office use since 1972.
conversion residential to commercial for dcp determination
underpin west wall of above property
